name: ProductCard
description: S2A ProductCard v2 with native whole-card links, visible text at rest, and optional decorative hover image. ProductRouter supplies the Homepage's 254px minimum height.

notes: href produces one native anchor with the heading as its accessible name.
Keyboard focus reveals the same image as hover; reduced motion removes the fade.
This is a fixed dark-surface treatment. The Homepage product band supplies its dark backing.
